oracle_build: CMake Release, GCC 16.2.0 (Homebrew), OPENTRIM_BUILD_GUI=OFF, CXXFLAGS='-include cmath -D finite(x)=std::isfinite(x)' for macOS portability; no source edits
oracle_license: MIT (Tier A); its SRIM-2013 and SRIM-1996 electronic stopping (Tier C data) is never selected; DPASS (Tier C) is not used either
host: Darwin arm64, 28 logical CPUs, load average 18.7 at start

timing.ions_per_s: end-to-end process wall clock at the run's ion count (setup, table builds and output writing included)
timing.ions_per_s_marginal: (N2 - N1) / (t2 - t1) between runs of N1 = 20000 and N2 = 100000 ions: throughput with fixed setup costs removed
timing.threads: every code capped at 2 worker threads (--threads); speed ratios are not comparable with summaries run on all logical CPUs

oracle_settings.tallies: IonStop by depth (bins 0.05 nm, atom_id 0) and IonExit through x = 0 by species
oracle_settings.timing: end-to-end process wall clock, including setup and writing the HDF5 file

matched: electronic stopping off on both sides (lindhard stopping = none; OpenTRIM electronic_stopping = Off)
constant free path N^(-1/3) (flight_path_const = (4 pi/3)^(1/3) R_at) and its p_max disc
density and masses as echoed by lindhard
mismatches: random-number streams differ (different generators); agreement is statistical only
one energy cutoff (Transport/min_energy) for the beam ion and recoils, set to lindhard's primary cutoff
E_b = 0 in lindhard; OpenTRIM's El has a minimum of 0.001 eV
replacement energy Er set to E_d (OpenTRIM doc/damage.md); lindhard's replacement rule is its own
finite box (depth x 100 nm x 100 nm, laterally periodic) instead of a semi-infinite target
ZBL scattering from OpenTRIM's interpolation tables; lindhard a Gauss-Mehler table in (eps, beta)
normal incidence along +x; first-flight convention not documented
